title: https (ssl) support for local web services?
symptom: Garmin has removed http access from their web request API, breaking xDrip+ web services. Users report that the latest Garmin Connect Mobile app no longer works properly with xDrip+ local web services.
cause: Garmin intentionally removed http access in their Connect Mobile app, and xDrip's SSL support would require a certificate that fails chain verification because it isn't signed by a certification authority.
fix: Garmin fixed their app by including localhost (127.0.0.1) in the exceptions list for GCM, available in version 4.22, allowing Garmin apps to communicate with xDrip+ again.
evidence_quote: Garmin has fixed their app Garmin Connect Mobile. With version 4.22 Garmin apps can communicate again with xDrip+.
